dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is a joke coin created in 2013 to mock Bitcoin spinoffs. How have we all forgotten this? I mean I love that giant Shiba Inu head, but really?

Elon Musk predicted that the meme-based bitcoin rival DOGECOIN, or some other cryptocurrency, will eventually be the official currency of Mars— Musk has previously hinted at a proposed project to use his rocket company SpaceX to “put a literal dogecoin on the literal moon.”
